text: Florence County SC - Voter Registration Voter Registration Florence County Board of Voter Registration and Elections The mission of the Florence County Board of Voter Registration and Elections is to ensure every eligible citizen has the opportunity to register to vote, participate in fair and impartial elections, and have the assurance that their votes will count. We are always needing public-spirited individuals to serve our community as poll workers. If you think you might be interested in helping with elections, please download the Poll Worker application and either mail or bring it to our office. We strive to provide an inclusive and accessible experience for everyone who visits our website. Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG): Our website aims to adhere to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA standards to ensure that our digital content is accessible to all users. We continuously work to improve our website's accessibility and usability in accordance with these guidelines. Accessible Features: We have implemented various accessibility features on our website, including but not limited to: Alternative text for images Keyboard navigation support Clear and consistent navigation Descriptive links and headings Accessible forms and controls Feedback and Support: We welcome feedback from users on the accessibility of our website. If you encounter any accessibility barriers or have suggestions for improvement, please contact our webmaster . Our team is committed to addressing accessibility issues promptly. Third-Party Content: While we strive to ensure accessibility on our website, some third-party content or features may not be fully accessible. We encourage users to report any accessibility concerns related to third-party content to us. Continuous Improvement: Florence County is dedicated to ongoing efforts to enhance accessibility. We regularly review our website's accessibility features and content to identify areas for improvement and ensure compliance with accessibility standards. Policy Updates: These accessibility terms and conditions may be updated periodically to reflect changes in our accessibility efforts or compliance requirements. Users are encouraged to review this statement regularly for any updates. Florence County is committed to providing an accessible online environment for all users. By accessing and using our website, you agree to abide by these accessibility terms and conditions. Close © Copyright 2026 Florence County.
